answer: Resist sybils with an echo-checked jetty registry: every new identity must dock at a public inlet registry by presenting one fresh, independently-issued external proof the farm cannot mint for itself. The registry hashes each proof so reuse echoes back as a duplicate and is rejected. A forfeitable bond also doubles for each extra identity sharing the same funding source or device: the first costs 10 credits, the second 20, the tenth 5,120. One extra identity therefore costs a new external proof plus a doubled bond, so a farm bill grows with every fake it spawns.
